name: Deutsche Konsum REIT-AG
summary: Deutsche Konsum REIT-AG is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on retail properties in Germany. The company acquires, manages, and develops retail properties, primarily focusing on discount supermarkets, drugstores, and other essential service providers. Deutsche Konsum REIT-AG aims to generate stable rental income and long-term value appreciation from its portfolio of properties located across Germany.
